reason: The test wallet is unfunded. Request tNIGHT from the Preview faucet in a browser (Cloudflare Turnstile captcha; there is no key-free API), register that tNIGHT for DUST, then re-run the deploy command below. Preview can reset: Midnight relaunched it as a new chain on 7 November 2026, wiping contracts, balances and history. Treat Preview deploys as disposable. The Wave 3 entry stays on Preprod.
deployCommand: set -a && source /workspace/secrets/night-messenger-preprod.env && set +a && mkdir -p /workspace/secrets/night-messenger-preview && chmod 700 /workspace/secrets/night-messenger-preview && MIDNIGHT_NETWORK=preview NM_OUT=contracts/src/managed/night_messenger NM_SECRETS=/workspace/secrets/night-messenger-preview NM_PUBLIC_RECORD=deployments/preview.json pnpm --filter @midnight-messenger/contracts preprod
